story.title: Knocked and Rocked Asleep
story.blurb: Knocked out aboard the ship, Zach wakes in a dark place between dreaming and dying, where a voice with red eyes asks what he dreads.

lines.text: KRACK!

segments.text: KRACK!

lines.text: With a solid slam to his head, Zach fell to the floor of the ship, greeted with darkness and the cold, hard ground. The murmuring of his “Crew Mates” slowly lost volume until there was nothing but a senseless darkness.

It was a while before Zach could register anything. The darkness made it impossible to tell if he had fully awakened, or if he was simply in a strange dream state. However, in the darkness, it felt as if… as if he wasn’t alone.
“Smart realization.”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: Smart realization.

lines.text: Wheeling around, Zach realized his vision hadn’t been lost. Rather, wherever he was was pitch dark, with the only discernible image being two dark, red eyes. Zach reached for Oblivion, but it wasn’t there.
“Zach, is it? I see you’ve entered a unique state between Dreaming and Dying. Lucky you!”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: Zach, is it? I see you’ve entered a unique state between Dreaming and Dying. Lucky you!

lines.text: The eyes shift up, as if the body the eyes were attached to was standing up to its full height. With a solid 4 feet over Zach, the figure approached closer, towering over him.
“You’ve managed to find yourself in a very unique predicament. Entering this place with such a high sense of fear and stress… It’s no wonder I get to meet you.”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: You’ve managed to find yourself in a very unique predicament. Entering this place with such a high sense of fear and stress… It’s no wonder I get to meet you.

lines.text: With a sniff of Zach’s neck, the figure slinks behind and around the human, seemingly basking in the tension of the moment.

“Hmm, and I know that smell… Seth really does have a way of sowing the seeds of Fear, doesn’t he? All that insanity can do wonders to a person, and even worse for their… associates. But alas, I’m not here to dwell on my past, nor your future. I’m here with a question, Zach.”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: Hmm, and I know that smell… Seth really does have a way of sowing the seeds of Fear, doesn’t he? All that insanity can do wonders to a person, and even worse for their… associates. But alas, I’m not here to dwell on my past, nor your future. I’m here with a question, Zach.

lines.text: And as the voice mentioned Seth, it shifted from one of darkness, a noise of scraping nails on a chalkboard and the growls of beasts in the night, to an almost… feminine undertone. It didn’t take long for Zach’s mind to leave that discovery, as the apparition met Zach’s eyes.
“What do you Fear, Zach? What do you Dread?”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: What do you

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: Fear,

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: Zach? What do you

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: Dread?

lines.text: Zach is paralyzed, he doesn’t know how to answer the question, what does he dread? Well, a lot of things, really… his crew hating him, which is reality. His fiancé leaving him, which also might become a reality. And, while not as much anymore, John. But right now-
“The fact that I might be dead… is this Hell?”

segments.speaker: Zacharias Smith
segments.text: The fact that I might be dead… is this Hell?

lines.text: The pair of glowing eyes bounce and a low rumbling resonates throughout the area… Was it… laughing?
“Oh, Zach… you sure are amusing. And it’s almost sad that history seems to be repeating itself…”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: Oh, Zach… you sure are amusing. And it’s almost sad that history seems to be repeating itself…

lines.text: Zach is pissed now, he’s having a crisis, and all this voice is doing is just seeing him as cheap entertainment, not only that, but is it… sympathizing with him?

lines.text: “What the Hell do you know? You don’t know what it’s like to be in a group full of idiots after being abused for over 20 years. And then when all is done, the gun is still pointed at you! Oh, why am I even talking? You’re just some disembodied voice who already seems to want to kill me. So-” Zach sits cross-legged. “-make it quick…” The voice laughs again.

lines.text: “Tsk tsk, if only you knew, Zach…-” The sound of boot clicks rings out through the space, Zach closes his eyes, waiting for the final blow. Finally, he can die in peace. The clicks stop just in front of him. “Just how similar the two of us really are.” The voice is even more feminine now, Zach is confused. He opens his eyes and what he sees isn’t what he was expecting to see while in this situation. A… woman? Yeah, a woman stands there in form-fitting red and black shirt, shorts, and boots. Her skin and hair, green and plant-like. And finally her eyes, bottomless black voids. She has a smug smile, and the yellow flower in her hair glares at Zach with its one eye. Zach should be intimidated, but for some reason, he’s not…

She has a smug smile, and the yellow flower in her hair glares at Zach with its one eye. Zach should be intimidated, but for some reason, he’s not…

lines.text: “If my intentions were to kill you, we wouldn’t be talking. I rarely kill myself, not in this manner, at least. No use using a cannon when a knife will do. No, consider this simply a… conversation with a God.”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: If my intentions were to kill you, we wouldn’t be talking. I rarely kill myself, not in this manner, at least. No use using a cannon when a knife will do. No, consider this simply a… conversation with a God.

lines.text: The God of Dread paced, surveying Zach with the gaze of a predator, taking in every minute movement. Her form seemed to crack and shift, changing as she returned to face Zach. Now clad in a sleeveless outfit, the red lines of her attire pulsed in the darkness. Crouching to meet his eye level, she pulled the flower from her hair. As she slid her hand along the stem, it transformed into a spear, which she plunged into the ground.
“Would you prefer that I treat you the same as the others, Zach? You’re far from the first to reach this realm, and the fate of those who came before is far worse than death.”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: Would you prefer that I treat you the same as the others, Zach? You’re far from the first to reach this realm, and the fate of those who came before is far worse than death.

lines.text: Her face changed yet again, jittering and spinning, as the green skin drained to brown and cracked away like the fall leaves. Staring back at Zach was instead the face of his fiancé, Jack.
“Please, Zach, I don’t have much time. We’ve tried to get through to you, but nothing seems to be working. You have to wake up, you have tooooOOOOUUUUHHH-”

segments.speaker: Jack Madison
segments.text: Please, Zach, I don’t have much time. We’ve tried to get through to you, but nothing seems to be working. You have to wake up, you have tooooOOOOUUUUHHH-

lines.text: The face contorts, as brambles beginning to burst from the face’s nostrils and tear ducts, spiraling their way down its throat. As its mouth expands, a small baby hand begins to pull itself out of the throat, bearing the familiar face of John.
“Nothing but a no-good, rotten, useless little freak! When I get my hands on you, I’ll make hell seem like a vacation, do you hear me!”

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: Nothing but a no-good, rotten, useless little freak! When I get my hands on you, I’ll make hell seem like a vacation, do you hear me!

lines.text: The mouth clamps down, and the god’s head falls off, tumbling into the darkness. As she stands, she offers a hand down to Zach. From the base of her neck, a small seed grows and grows, until it buds into the flower once adorned in her hair, and her skin now roils with cracks, almost akin to black magma underneath the tribal-esque gashes.

“No, Zach, I’m not here for death nor torment. Ironically, the soft spot I hold for the past is what spared you this time. The same reason you find yourself talking to me is the very reason you get to walk away. So, allow this deity to quell your fear.”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: No, Zach, I’m not here for death nor torment. Ironically, the soft spot I hold for the past is what spared you this time. The same reason you find yourself talking to me is the very reason you get to walk away. So, allow this deity to quell your fear.

lines.text: The body began to step back, approaching the darkness. As her body began to be enveloped, the eye of the flower remained.
“You aren’t dead, Zach. Not this time. But who knows?”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: You aren’t dead, Zach. Not this time. But who knows?

lines.text: The eye closed itself, and the eyelid reopened with a grinning smile.
“After all… the end IS nigh…”

segments.speaker: Dread
segments.text: After all… the end IS nigh…

lines.text: And with that, Zach awoke.
